title: How to Process Member Refunds and Account Cancellations

sections.heading: Refunding a Member Transaction
sections.content:
To issue a full or partial refund to a member:
1. Navigate to Finance > Transaction History in your admin menu.
2. Locate the specific invoice or transaction using member name or invoice ID.
3. Click the 'Action' dropdown on the right side of the transaction row.
4. Select 'Issue Refund'.
5. Specify whether you are issuing a Full Refund or Partial Refund (enter the refund dollar amount).
6. Check the box if you want to notify the member by email.
7. Click the red 'Confirm Refund' button. The refund is automatically transmitted to Stripe or PayPal.

sections.heading: Handling Member Cancellation
sections.content: When a member cancels their subscription, you can immediately cancel access or allow them to remain active until the end of their current paid billing period under My Members > Manage Members > Edit Member Status.

procedural_steps: Locate the transaction by invoice ID or member name
Choose Full Refund or Partial Refund and enter amount

full_text:
Refunding a Member Transaction
To issue a full or partial refund to a member:
1. Navigate to Finance > Transaction History in your admin menu.
2. Locate the specific invoice or transaction using member name or invoice ID.
3. Click the 'Action' dropdown on the right side of the transaction row.
4. Select 'Issue Refund'.
5. Specify whether you are issuing a Full Refund or Partial Refund (enter the refund dollar amount).
6. Check the box if you want to notify the member by email.
7. Click the red 'Confirm Refund' button. The refund is automatically transmitted to Stripe or PayPal.

Handling Member Cancellation
When a member cancels their subscription, you can immediately cancel access or allow them to remain active until the end of their current paid billing period under My Members > Manage Members > Edit Member Status.
